overview.name: Tradr 2X Short META Daily ETF
overview.description: Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times inverse leveraged exposure to the daily performance of META. META focuses on building technologies that enable human connection. META’s products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (“VR”) headsets, and artificial intelligence (“AI”) glasses. It is non-diversified.
